title: Customizable /heal and /feed
description: This project adds /heal and /feed so server OPs can heal and feed who they wish.
body:
## Customizable `/heal` and `/feed` commands that allows you to heal yourself and others.
- `/heal` allows you to heal yourself
- `/heal [player]` allows you to heal other players
- `/feed` allows you to feed yourself
- `/feed [player]` allows you to feed other players
- `/healfeed reload` reloads plugin settings instantly

For any of these options, the health, hunger and saturation can be configured in `config.yml` by toggling the value `true/false`
